name: hubble
description: A personal GitHub dashboard for any user in any organisation

scripts.ci:check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck

//security: npm audit reports a brace-expansion DoS (<=5.0.7) reaching us through ESLint's minimatch@3. It is accepted, not ignored: it is a devDependency that never ships to the browser, and it is only reachable by linting adversarial glob patterns. It cannot currently be fixed -- brace-expansion@5 changed its export shape, so overriding it to a patched release breaks minimatch@3 with 'expand is not a function', and `npm audit fix --force` resolves it only by downgrading ESLint. Re-check when ESLint drops minimatch@3.
